state.title: Alternative Fuel Vehicle (AFV) Conversion and Infrastructure Tax Credit
state.sum: Businesses and individuals are eligible for an income tax credit of 50% of the equipment and labor costs for the conversion of qualified AFVs, up to $19,000 per vehicle for individuals and corporations, and no dollar limit for unincorporated businesses.

laws.title: Electric Vehicle (EV) Charging Building Standards
laws.sum: New construction of, or substantial improvements to, single family homes with off-street parking must include at least one EV-ready parking space capable of providing Level 1 charging.
laws.ref: Council Bill 25-262, 2024 and District of Columbia Code 6-1451.03a to 6-1451.03b

laws.title: Electric Vehicle (EV) Charger Policies for Condominiums
laws.sum: Condominium associations may not prohibit or restrict the installation or use of EV chargers in a homeowner’s designated parking space. Condominium associations may put reasonable restrictions on EV chargers, but the policies may not significantly increase the cost of the EV charger or prohibit installation.
laws.ref: District of Columbia Code 6-1451.03c and Council Bill 25-262, 2024

laws.title: Electric Vehicle (EV) Charging Station Building Standards
laws.sum: New construction and renovation of commercial buildings and multi-unit dwellings with three or more off-street parking spaces, must reserve a minimum of 20% of parking spaces for EV charging station-ready infrastructure.

Infrastructure: EV Level 2 Charging Station Purchase Rebate
